newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AMP confirms not preferred bidder for ScotAm.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AMP confirms not preferred bidder for ScotAm.

text.p: The Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP) on Tuesday confirmed it had not been chosen as the preferred bidder for the Scottish Amicable Life Assurance Society in Britain.
AMP said in a statement it was "surprised and disappointed" not to have been chosen.

Managing director George Trumbull said AMP had offered a full value bid which would have preserved Scottish Amicable and expanded its operations in line with AMP's strategy for development of its business in Britain and Europe.
AMP, Australia's largest funds manager, was competing with Prudential Corp Plc and Abbey National Plc for the British insurance group.
